info.title: GoSystem Tax Return API
info.description: This API exposes features for working with GoSystem Tax Returns.

post.summary: Open a tax return for editing
post.description: This endpoint opens a tax return for editing. You must call this endpoint before calling other tax return operations.

200.description: Success - Tax return opened successfully. Returns session tokens required for subsequent operations.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid input parameters, validation errors, or business logic failures. Includes model validation errors, account/tax return existence validation, tax year range errors, and password requirements.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid authentication, incorrect passwords, or insufficient user permissions. Includes JWT token issues, password errors for protected returns, and user access failures.

403.description: Forbidden - Valid authentication but insufficient permissions to access the resource. Includes user group access control failures, account access restrictions, and group assignment issues.

404.description: Not Found - The requested tax return can't be found in the system.

500.description: Internal Server Error - Server-side errors during tax return opening process. Includes tax return busy states, generic system errors, and data corruption issues.

503.description: Service Unavailable - Dependent services are temporarily unavailable. Includes database connectivity issues and system maintenance scenarios.

value.description: State Return: The City of Philadelphia requires that the State of Pennsylvaia return be active in order to file the city return.
Philadelphia: The City of Philadelphia requires the city account number to match the Entity ID (EIN).
Philadelphia: The City of Philadelphia requires the account number/ID to be active.

Form DR 8453P: Colorado does not require that the DR 8453P to be attached as a pdf to the efiled partnership return in order accept and process the return, but it must be available upon demand from the preparer.

Common State: Federal attachments are not provided for states that require a complete federal return. Please check the filing requirements for the following state returns: DC, Philadelphia,Fayette,Lexington-Fayette,
Common State E-file Alert: Please review and verify that the PIN is accurate and that the preparer is the registered owner of the PTIN.

Foreign Address of Paid Preparer: DC does not accept a foreign address when electronically filing a D-65. To file using a foreign address of the preparer you  will need to file on paper. DCPTRHDR-0014

Partner Allocations: Partner Allocations have not been enabled.  Amounts will not be computed for the Schedule K-1s.  To enable partner allocations, select Options from the menu bar and then select Partner Allocations.

Filing Period for Nevada Commerce Tax: Nevada has a tax year of July 1 to June 30.   Returns for a filing period cover the period between these two dates.  Returns for a filing year are not to be filed until after June 3th UNLESS the business closes before the end of the filing period.   If that is the case the business is to indicate on the form that it is a final return.  If the business is still active, the return will be rejected.
